title: Incremental context benefit of one retained owner-decision experience on a held-out chapter
revision_reason: The first criteria draft was 630 characters and the workflow admission limit is 600; the refused launch made no model call. Criteria were shortened before either arm ran.

code_freeze.note: Mission documentation only; the experiment executes against ALIVE.

research_questions.question: Does adding the workspace's existing context-only owner-decision experience change the quality of a later chapter proposal compared with no experience?
Does an independently evaluated lesson transfer to a different held-out chapter?
research_questions.reason: No independently evaluated lesson is eligible. The only eligible experience is quality-unverified: its original evaluation failed at the old token ceiling and owner acceptance is context, not proof.

criteria.text: Improve economy in "Data Filtering and Curriculum Learning" without dropping technical claims, citations, uncertainty or the chapter's argument. The chapter reports a negative result; keep the negative result, its measured differences and why the curriculum arms ran fewer updates. Preserve reported numbers, the four regimes, distribution effects, difficulty and diversity measures, rights and provenance limits, and its stated limits. Keep each section's substance and approximate length; do not omit material. Return a complete proposal; do not write the source.

design.type: one pre-registered pair; no replication; no rerun after seeing outcomes
design.unit: one held-out whole chapter, sectioned improvement

irrelevant_experience_control.reason: Only one eligible owner decision exists in this workspace. A second eligible item would require a new owner decision before the experiment; without it, relevance specificity cannot be separated from added context. No claim of relevance specificity follows.

independent_evaluation.scale: 0 materially fails; 1 weak; 2 adequate with notable gaps; 3 strong; 4 exceptionally strong. Rubric judgments, not measurements.
independent_evaluation.note: The evaluator is a separate blind role with a frozen rubric, but it is the same model family as the generator. It is not human or third-party review.

secondary.name: delta_total
secondary.definition: sum over six dimensions of (proposed score - original score), range -24..24

secondary.name: delta_economy
secondary.definition: proposed economy score - original economy score

secondary.name: preservation_attention
secondary.definition: number of mechanical checks whose status is attention

secondary.name: receipts
secondary.definition: run ids, model invocation ids, charged tokens and Pi receipts for both arms and both evaluations

outcome_rules.valid_comparison: Both improvement runs COMPLETED with complete provenance and the exact frozen plan, source and (for B) experience context sha256. Both independent evaluations COMPLETED with the frozen rubric and valid quotes.
outcome_rules.benefit_observed: B verdict is benefit; A verdict is not benefit; B delta_total > A delta_total; B delta_economy > A delta_economy; B preservation_attention <= A preservation_attention; every B guardrail delta is >= 0 and not below A; every attention item is explained in preservation_observations.
outcome_rules.harm_observed: B verdict is harm, or any B guardrail delta < 0, or B preservation_attention > A preservation_attention, or B delta_total < A delta_total.
outcome_rules.no_benefit_observed: The comparison is valid and neither benefit_observed nor harm_observed applies.
outcome_rules.inconclusive: Either evaluation failed or returned inconclusive, a required receipt or identity is missing, the frozen context was not injected, or the signals conflict.
outcome_rules.label_meaning: These labels describe one pre-registered pair. benefit_observed is not proof of learning, quality, or general transfer.

budget.hard_stop: No third improvement run and no rerun to obtain a more favourable result.

failure_conditions: Source, plan, section hashes, criteria or model differ from this manifest.
B's experience_retrieval.context_sha256 differs from the frozen value.
An improvement run does not complete with a retained proposal.
An independent evaluation fails, quotes text absent from a version, or changes its rubric.
Any manuscript source write, decision change or promotion change occurs.
non_claims: The experience used in B is not an independently evaluated lesson; its original evaluation failed and it remains quality-unverified.
One pair cannot establish general transfer, statistical significance or a durable learning effect.
Owner acceptance is context, not quality evidence.
A model verdict is an assessment, not proof or publication readiness.
The evaluator shares a model family with the generator.
No irrelevant-experience control was run; relevance specificity is untested.
No manuscript was edited, promoted or deployed.
